articles.title: Kältewelle in den USA: Florida erwartet tiefste Temperaturen seit 1989
articles.teaser: Der US-Wetterdienst warnt vor einem "Küstenzyklon". Weitere Schneefälle und heftige Winde verstärken die aktuelle Kaltfront, in Florida ist mit Frost zu rechnen.
articles.image_title: Kältewelle in den USA: A pedestrian walks past a bus stop with an advertisement for Florida during a winter blizzard in Boston, Massachusetts February 15, 2015. The U.S. Northeast faced yet another major winter storm at the weekend, with blizzard conditions in six states' coastal regions, much of which is already buried under record-setting snow, forecasters said. In Boston, snow fell hard Saturday afternoon, pausing for an evening lull before picking up again. Forecasters predicted accumulations of up to 14 inches (36 cm) of snow through Sunday. REUTERS/Brian Snyder (UNITED STATES - Tags: ENVIRONMENT)

articles.title: US-Migrationspolitik: Proteste gegen ICE in mehr als 45 US-Bundesstaaten
articles.teaser: Zehntausende Menschen sind in Minneapolis und im ganzen Land gegen die Migrationspolitik von Donald Trump auf die Straße gegangen. Schulen blieben teils geschlossen.
articles.image_title: US-Migrationspolitik: MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA - JANUARY 30: Protestors march as part of a "Nationwide Shutdown" demonstration against ICE enforcement on January 30, 2026 in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Protests continue calling for an end to immigration raids in the Twin Cities which have already resulted in the deaths of Alex Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse at a VA medical center who died January 24, after being shot multiple times during a brief altercation with border patrol agents, and Renee Good a 37-year-old mother of three children who was killed by ICE agents on January 7th.

articles.title: Mord an Brian Thompson: Richterin schließt Todesstrafe für Luigi M. aus
articles.teaser: Ein Jahr nach dem Attentat auf den Chef eines US-Krankenversicherers wurde die Todesstrafe für den Angeklagten ausgeschlossen. Eine lebenslange Haft sei aber möglich.
articles.image_title: Mord an Brian Thompson: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - DECEMBER 19: Luigi Mangione, suspect in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in New York City, arrives at a heliport with members of the NYPD on December 19, 2024 in New York City. The 26-year-old was arrested in Pennsylvania on December 9 after being spotted at a McDonald's in Altoona amid a national manhunt. Mangione also appeared in a Pennsylvania court on forgery and firearms charges today, where he waived extradition to New York after being indicted on 11 charges including first-degree murder in furtherance of terrorism. (Photo by Stephanie Keith/Getty Images)
